messages:
Jordan (CSM): Quick heads-up — Whisper Health usage down ~62% week-over-week. Renew in 45 days. New ML lead (Ravi) left last Friday; they confirmed an internal 'tech review' with StellarAI running a short pilot. Can we triage risk + recommended next steps?

Ellie (CS Ops): yikes. Do we have token-level usage + error spikes? Also who owns procurement?

Ada (Solutions Eng): I'll pull recent request logs. Possible perf regressions after model update on 2025-03-18.

Jordan (CSM): Procurement is handled by Matt (CTO). Matt, are they leaning toward StellarAI for cost reasons or features?

Matt (CTO - Whisper Health): short answer: both. Stellar pitched faster inference at 50% lower token cost. Our execs asked for side-by-side. Not committed yet.

Sam (AE): looping in legal/procurement timeline — renewal is 2025-04-30. Can CSM run quick fidelity eval? Sam to prep pricing retention band.

Ada (Solutions Eng): Query I'll run: 
```
SELECT client_id, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, avg_latency_ms
FROM token_usage
WHERE client_id='whisper_health' AND ts >= '2025-03-01'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```
Expect to find latency bump on 2025-03-18. Will report in 90m.

Jordan (CSM): Thanks. Also they reported hallucination increase in summaries. Any known model config changes?

Ada (Solutions Eng): Ops changed model variant to gptx-3.5-eco on 2025-03-18 for cost-saving experiments — not rolled back. That likely explains both hallucinations + cost drop. Recommend roll back to gptx-3.5-prod for a canary.

Ellie (CS Ops): I'll create a short enablement playbook for them to revert and test. @pipelines-bot can you snapshot current rollout config for whisper_health?

pipelines-bot: Snapshot created: snapshot_2025_03_22_08_12 (links: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/whisper_health/2025-03-22)

Sam (AE): If they commit to Dedicated or a 6-month reserved plan we can offer a $20k credit for migration and a one-week white-glove perf tune. Would that move needle?

Jordan (CSM): Good tactic. Next steps: Ada to send findings + config diff, Ellie to prep playbook & quick runbook for rollback, Sam to draft retention offer, Jordan to schedule 30m call with Matt + ML lead replacement. I'll update deal risk to 'high' in Salesforce.

Matt (CTO - Whisper Health): We're open to a perf tune. Can we get a perf baseline and expected latency/cost after tune?

Ada (Solutions Eng): Will include baseline + post-tune projection. ETA 4h.

Jordan (CSM): Scheduling: target sync today EOD. If everyone ok I'll send calendar invite + agenda.

Ellie (CS Ops): :thumbsup:

Sam (AE): +1

Jordan (CSM): Added action items in thread. Thanks team.
